inlines.v: RELIG'IOUSLY, adverb 1. Piously; with love and reverence to the Supreme Being; in obedience to the divine commands. 2. According to the rites of religion. 3. Reverently; with veneration. 4. Exactly; strictly; conscientiously; as a vow or promise religiously observed.
